title: HTML & CSS Fundamentals
description: Master the building blocks of web development with questions on HTML structure and CSS styling.

questions.question: Which HTML5 semantic element should be used for the main navigation menu?
questions.explanation: The <nav> element is the correct HTML5 semantic element for navigation menus. It helps with accessibility and SEO.

questions.question: What is the CSS Box Model order from inside to outside?
questions.explanation: The CSS Box Model order from inside to outside is: content → padding → border → margin.

questions.question: Which CSS property is used to create flexible layouts?
questions.explanation: The display: flex; property enables flexbox layout, which is designed for creating flexible and responsive layouts.

questions.question: What does the 'alt' attribute in an tag provide?
questions.explanation: The 'alt' attribute provides alternative text that describes the image, important for accessibility and when images fail to load.

questions.question: Which CSS unit is relative to the font size of the root element?
questions.explanation: rem (root em) is relative to the root element's font size. em is relative to the parent element's font size.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the <meta charset='UTF-8'> tag?
questions.explanation: The charset meta tag defines the character encoding for the HTML document, ensuring proper display of all characters.

questions.question: Which CSS selector has the highest specificity?
questions.explanation: ID selectors have the highest specificity among these options. Inline styles have even higher specificity, and !important overrides all.

questions.question: What does the CSS property 'position: absolute;' do?
options: Positions element relative to its normal position
Positions element relative to nearest positioned ancestor
Removes element from document flow completely
questions.explanation: position: absolute; positions the element relative to its nearest positioned (non-static) ancestor, or the document if none exists.

questions.question: Which HTML attribute is used to open a link in a new tab?
questions.explanation: The target='_blank' attribute opens the link in a new browser tab or window. For security, it's recommended to also use rel='noopener'.

questions.question: What does the CSS 'z-index' property control?
questions.explanation: The z-index property controls the stacking order of positioned elements, determining which elements appear on top of others.
